scope: All current structured task records and exported JSONL syntax/provenance fields; not exhaustive semantic verification of every transcript

limits: Field presence is not proof of semantic correctness or future capture
Structured task metadata is agent-authored; available text/tool transcripts are explicit automatic exports
Initial setup reconstruction remains labeled and does not claim native hooks
Five actual native CLI lifecycle events do not prove activation in the existing IDE session
No configured-but-unused connector, exact unknown model, human judgment, recording or upload is fabricated
Best-effort redaction and original source references remain documented; no private/system/reasoning export is claimed
